title: Outreach: all three in one place
question: Quick walk from your door (the casual default), take a patch (more effort), and outreach days, all in one Outreach area reached from the Hub. Which arrangement should lead?

options.label: Part of the week
options.thesis: Outreach sits in the church's week: outreach days are events on their day, free evenings offer a walk from your door, and the week's patch goal sits up top.
options.viewport: Masthead with this week's coverage goal; a seven-day strip; an agenda where Saturday's outreach day, a suggested 45-minute walk on Thursday, and two open patches appear as rows.
options.risk: Outreach only shows when you look at the week, and suggested walks in free time may feel like nagging.

options.label: One map, three lenses
options.lineage: map apps with a mode sheet
options.thesis: One coverage map of the suburb; a sheet switches between From my door, Patches and Outreach day, and the map redraws for each.
options.viewport: Full-screen map tinted by coverage; a sheet with a segmented control (From my door selected), quick choices of 30 min, 1 hr, 2 hr, and the generated loop's letterboxes and bundles.
options.risk: The map leads even for someone who just wants 'give me an hour's walk', and three modes in one sheet can blur.

options.label: Changes with the moment
options.thesis: One Outreach page whose top block follows the moment: the live board on an outreach day, otherwise a one-tap walk from your door; patches and coming days follow below.
options.viewport: Masthead; a big 'Walk from your door' card with time choices and a ready loop; a 'Take a patch' row of the freshest nearby patches; 'Outreach days' with Saturday's day and Join.
options.risk: A long stacked page; the top changing with the moment needs a clear rule or it feels unpredictable.
